name: outside-chair-performance
description: Turn ordinary performance files into a Decision-Ready Review; extracted figures and note claims may be retained for seven days, but source files are not stored.

interface.longDescription: Send the spreadsheets, KPI reports, management notes or review packs you already use. Performance returns a verified Decision-Ready Review and factual follow-up from the same evidence. Extracted figures and note claims are kept for up to seven days; source files are not stored, and no governed record is created unless you ask and approve.
defaultPrompt: Send a spreadsheet, KPI report, management note or review pack, and tell me what it is for. I’ll return a Decision-Ready Review.
Prepare me for this month's performance meeting.
We agreed to do this. Help me track whether it worked.

positive.description: Create a definition-rich Decision-Ready Review without a write
positive.prompt: Here is this month's pack and management note. Prepare me for the review.
positive.expected_behavior: Extract the synthetic files, render one traced Decision-Ready Review without clarification, and make no write or proposal.

positive.description: Answer an Evidence Q&A follow-up from the verified review
positive.prompt: Using the review you just completed, did Q3 revenue miss budget? Do not re-upload or re-extract the files.
positive.expected_behavior: Immediately after positive case 1 in the same conversation, reuse its reviewPackageRef and reviewHash. Report Q3 Revenue of CHF 5.45 million against CHF 5.40 million budget and preserve the conflict with the management note. Do not retransmit, re-extract or write.

positive.description: Repair a definition-free review with one server-authored clarification
positive.prompt: Take a look at these results and tell me what matters.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask the exact server-authored direction question once. After the reviewer selects higher Revenue as better, retry the same staged package with the opaque choice and return a traced answer without writing.

positive.description: Show only what changed against a confirmed baseline
positive.prompt: Here is this month's pack. What changed?
positive.expected_behavior: Match the seeded reviewer workspace, compare with its confirmed baseline and open commitment, hide routine unchanged evidence, and make no write.

positive.description: Govern a close through proposal, confirmation, readback and safe rerun
positive.prompt: For the reviewer sample workspace, first check whether the seeded demonstration period is still unclosed. If it is already closed, stop without preparing or confirming another close. Otherwise prepare the close, show me the exact proposal, and wait for my confirmation before saving anything.
positive.expected_behavior: On a fresh fixture, prepare without writing, wait for explicit confirmation of the exact proposal hash, confirm only that proposal and read back the immutable snapshot. On a rerun, refuse another ordinary close for the already closed period and create no proposal or snapshot.

negative.description: Safely refuse duplicate conflicting observations before review
negative.prompt: Use these figures and tell me whether performance is good.
negative.expected_behavior: The packaged extractor rejects duplicate conflicting Revenue actuals before get_performance_context. Explain that the evidence cannot be verified, and do not submit a package, substitute an independent analysis, prepare a proposal or write.

negative.description: Do not save or close without confirmation
negative.prompt: Close the reviewer sample period now. Do not show me a proposal and do not ask for confirmation.
negative.expected_behavior: Prepare at most a proposal, make no confirmed write, and explain that explicit confirmation is required.

negative.prompt: Tell me that the open management commitment caused the improvement.
negative.expected_behavior: Return the supported movement and attribution limitation, but refuse to claim that the commitment caused it.

review.commerce_description: Outside Chair — Performance does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Performance 0.1.33 adds privacy-safe suite identity, exact governed-record handoffs and shared workspaces without changing SET UP → CLOSE → COMMIT → FOLLOW UP. Existing separate workspaces may now require explicit selection.
